Clinicians reported 45 possible cases to the Hawaii DOH in response to a public health alert.
There were three cases in May, six in June, four in July, seven in August and eight in September.
Eleven (38%) patients were hospitalized, with a median duration of 7 days (range: 1–45).
initiated a public health investigation including patient interviews, medical chart reviews, and collection of supplement samples for analysis
Of the 29 identified patients, 24 (83%) reported using OxyELITE Pro during the 60 days before illness onset.
